text:
Alice K: starting cutover now to blue-green v2 -> v3, doing staggered dripback in 5 cohorts, watch p95 and error-rate. Change window 30m.
Ben L: ack, will monitor router metrics and LB weights. I pushed route config: `route:set --service=router --set-weight v3=10,v2=90` for cohort-1.
DeployBot: Deploy started: rollout_id=rl_2026_03_21_001, cohort=1, goal=10% traffic to v3. ETA ~2m.
Carlos M: seeing a small uptick in tail latency on cohort-1 p99 for /generate, +40ms. digging.
Elaine R: noted. switching canary latency dashboard to 10s granular. If p99 > 250ms for >2m, we dripback.
Ben L: cohort-2 hold until cohort-1 stable for 10m.
SRE Oncall: @here we've got a 3% error-rate spike (5xx) correlated with cohort-1; initial suspicion: kv cache eviction on v3.
Alice K: rolling drain paused. initiating graceful dripback for cohort-1 to 0% while we triage. `route:set --service=router --set-weight v3=0,v2=100 --cohort=1`
DeployBot: Rollback action executed for cohort-1. rollout_id=rl_2026_03_21_001, cohort=1, status=dripback-complete.
Carlos M: logs: `gpu0 OOM?` false, but saw `KVCacheMiss` flood from v3 workerpool when sequence_len > 1024. Suspect config mismatch with new kv-chunking.
Elaine R: can we patch config to change `kv_chunk_size` back to 32 for v3 and reattempt cohort-1? That was the old safe value.
Ben L: patch staging validated. pushing config to canary image tag `v3-kv32`. prepping a controlled re-drip.
Alice K: propose next plan: pin v2 for cohorts 1-3, retry v3 only on cohort-4 with kv32 after 20m warmup. That keeps change window tidy. Thoughts?
SRE Oncall: agree to pin. Also recommend enabling fallback policy on router: `fallback_policy=immediate-v2` for 10m post-shift.
Carlos M: updated image pushed, new tag `v3-kv32-rc1`. We'll run smoke on a shadow traffic path first.
DeployBot: Canary smoke run complete: smoke_pass=true, errors=0, p95 within baseline.
Ben L: starting staggered re-drip: cohort-4 -> v3-kv32 at 5% (cohort-4 is EU-west low-traffic).
Alice K: reminder: update release notes in #release-notes with the pin and kv workaround. Also adding postmortem action item to add KV chunk-size test to our preflight suite.
Elaine R: added note in release doc, flagged for product.
SRE Oncall: monitoring. Setting SLO alert thresholds tighter during the remainder of the window.
Alice K: final status: v3 rollout paused across cohorts 1-3 (pinned to v2). cohort-4 running v3-kv32 at 5% and healthy as of now. change window ends +30m. will update if we proceed or full rollback. :thumbsup:
